meta_description:
shivya on September 17, 2026: "Last month, terrifying videos and images of the Nepal floods flooded our feeds.
 
I tried to connect friends of friends searching for missing family members through my tourism networks, and it led to a lot of heartbreak.
 
I followed a lot of the coverage of the floods on social media, international news channels, climate podcasts… and was surprised that hardly anyone was talking about how the loss of lives in these floods is deeply linked to the need for climate justice / climate finance.

Take the time to read this, share it, research further on these topics, because they will define our coming years on this planet 🥹🌏".
